description: Migration equivalence (MOD-D29 item 1, .github/workflows/migration-equivalence.yml). Names are files in tests/db/vendors; which servers are 6.0 targets and which are 5.17 sources comes from tests/db/migrate/matrix.json (MOD-D25). matrix.mjs turns this into the job matrices: push (the integration branch) and workstream (a ccr-43ba0785-hzlrj5-<topic> branch, MOD-D30) as listed; nightly in place on every target, and copies that take every vendor once as a source and once as a target, each into another vendor. A copy may name the time zone every JVM of the run uses (EQUIVALENCE_ZONE, default UTC): 5.17 stores some timestamps in it and the copy converts them to UTC (MOD-I141).
